test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 6 May 2005 is a Friday, then what will the day of the week on 25 September 2018?
solution: **Given:** 6 May 2005 was Friday. Now, 2005 to 2018 = 13 Years (10 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years). And, In 13 Years = 3 Leap years and 10 Ordinary Years. So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days, And, 10 Ordinary Years have 10 odd days. Total odd days = 6 + 10 = 16.
